column1: # Which Record Atlas region (the contract's `regions`, rings in the contract itself) each BIRTHPLACE this archive prints on a person's page
# belongs to, for the 'at the time' notes (site/src/pages/people/[slug].astro, kit/docs/era-notes.md). One row per place string AS PRINTED in the
# Birthplace row of a person who is not living and not noindex (the page offers a dated place-event nowhere else: a death has no place on the page,
# and a 'where found' is the search that produced the person, with no date). A region of '-' means: looked at, and no Atlas region covers it (or
# the string is not one place), so no note. A new birthplace in people.json fails tools/build-era.py --check until it is decided here. Mapped by
# hand against the Atlas's regions; erasnap.py then refuses any town whose point (data/era-towns.tsv, column 4 here names the town) lies within
# 15 km of its region's ring edge, outside the ring, or in a different region's ring. A place with no town is a country or a region named whole.
